bodyParagraphs: Set in the calm and natural surroundings of Torre delle Stelle, Savitri Yoganjoy offers a space to slow down, reconnect, and restore balance through guided yoga and wellness practices. Whether by the sea, in nature, or in a more private setting, each session is designed to gently align body and mind while embracing the peaceful rhythm of Sardinia.

From group classes to private sessions and immersive retreats, the experience is tailored to meet guests where they are. It is not just about movement, but about creating a moment of presence, where breath, environment, and energy come together in a simple yet meaningful way.
summaryBody: Savitri Yoganjoy provides flexible yoga and wellness sessions for all levels, from beginners to experienced practitioners. Guests can choose between group classes, private sessions, or fully immersive retreats, with options adapted to individual needs, schedules, and preferences.
quote: Impeccable organization, high-quality practices, magnificent locations, and a unique energy that only Barbara can instill.
supportingBody: Each session is designed with flexibility in mind, allowing guests to integrate wellness into their stay effortlessly, whether for a single class or a deeper, more immersive experience.
experienceBody: Practicing yoga in Sardinia brings a different kind of awareness, where the sound of the sea, the warmth of the air, and the natural surroundings become part of the experience itself. It is a gentle pause in the day, an opportunity to step away from routine and reconnect with a quieter, more grounded state of mind.
highlights: Flow with the rhythm of the sea
Experience yoga in its purest form

reviews.name: Yves Michali
reviews.text: Barbara is one of the top Yogi master i have ever met. She is incredibly talented and very knowledgeable about Yoga but also about the art of meditating, mindfulness, sound immersions. Her teaching skills and kindness will make your journey to Yoga as smooth as it gets and it will change the way you apprehend things forever ! Don’t wait .. just book your Yoga class with Savitri Yoganjoy. Namaste :)

reviews.name: ITALY DA
reviews.text: Practicing yoga with Savitri Barbara is a deeply rejuvenating experience. Her calm and serene presence creates a welcoming environment where each student can feel free to explore the practice authentically and without pressure. Her guidance is clear, attentive, and respectful of each student's needs. Savitri Barbara explains each pose with simplicity and precision, accompanying the practice with special attention to breathing and body awareness. Her classes instill balance, inner strength, and serenity, leaving a feeling of well-being that lasts long after the practice.

reviews.name: Gaetano De Stefano
reviews.text: Every yoga session with Savitri is a pleasant experience. With calm and experience, she guides you on a path that adapts to your every level. After a session, if you entered with tension and thoughts, you leave feeling peaceful and light, filled with renewed energy. I highly recommend trying one of her yoga sessions.

reviews.name: Jessica Maire
reviews.text:
Barbara is a true gem. I've been practicing with her online for years, and each class is a suspended moment, a gentle and profound reconnection with myself. Her voice, her clear explanations, her caring presence… everything contributes to creating a space where you feel safe, guided, and inspired.

I've also had the privilege of participating in two retreats in Sardinia with her, and it was simply magical. Impeccable organization, high-quality practices, magnificent locations, and a unique energy that only Barbara can instill.

Whether online or in person, her teaching is a gift. I wholeheartedly recommend her.

reviews.name: Aurora Tosi
reviews.text: Working with Barbara immediately proved to be a real blessing. She's a true professional who knows exactly what to offer, and she does so in an empathetic and unpretentious manner. Her voice is a discreet yet incredibly present guide during all her classes, which can be held both in person and online. I'm happy to have met her and recommend everyone to contact her.

bodyParagraphs: Guide Sardinia offers curated experiences that reveal the island through the eyes of those who know it best. From hidden beaches and archaeological sites to cultural landmarks and scenic landscapes, each journey is thoughtfully designed to go beyond the typical tourist path.

Led by experienced local guides, every tour becomes an immersive exploration of Sardinia’s history, nature, and traditions. Whether by land or sea, these experiences are crafted to connect you with the island in a meaningful and unforgettable way.
summaryBody: Each tour is carefully planned to balance discovery, comfort, and authenticity, offering guests a seamless way to explore Sardinia’s most remarkable locations with expert guidance.
quote: Very competent, helpful and kind guide.
supportingBody: Every route is shaped by local knowledge and attention to detail, ensuring each guest experiences Sardinia in a way that feels personal, smooth, and deeply enriching.
experienceBody: From coastal drives and hidden coves to cultural discoveries and panoramic viewpoints, each tour invites you to slow down and experience Sardinia with depth and perspective. It’s not just about seeing the island, but understanding it.
highlights: Hidden gems you wouldn’t find alone

reviews.name: Vince S
reviews.text: Wonderful experience with Guglielmo. He was very knowledgeable, personable and well suited for the job. Probably one of the best experiences we’ve had in our travels over many years. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Katrin R
reviews.text: Guglielmo's service is excellent. For over seven years, we have greatly appreciated his reliability, his open-mindedness, and his excellent knowledge of Sardinian history, lifestyle, and highlights. On each of our many trips, he inspires us anew, allowing us to discover more and more of Sardinia. We love listening to him, and the trips are always a wonderful experience. Thank you so much, dear friend.

reviews.name: sgargeum
reviews.text:
I have known Guglielmo for years and I must say that he is a guarantee from all points of view: punctual, professional and kind. If you want to book a transfer and you don't want to have any problems, well Guglielmo is the number 1 in Sardinia.

See you soon!

reviews.name: sienna2015
reviews.text:
Everything is perfect.

Professional driver, punctual, precise, kind. Van spotless.

Super recommended, if we return to Sardinia we will definitely lean on him.

reviews.name: Sarah
reviews.text: Gugliamo was fabulous. Excellent communication, timely with transfers and friendly but professional. He gave us very good recommendations which proved to be outstanding and we had a wonderful holiday thanks to his expertise.

bodyParagraphs: SAILOVER Arbatax offers unforgettable sailing experiences along one of Sardinia’s most breathtaking coastlines. From hidden coves to crystal-clear waters, each journey reveals landscapes that are only accessible by sea, far from the crowds and untouched by time.

Whether you choose a private charter or a shared excursion, every trip is guided by experienced crews who combine safety, comfort, and local knowledge. It’s a slow, immersive way to discover the island, where the rhythm of the sea defines the experience.
summaryTitle: A Day Shaped by the Sea
summaryBody: Each sailing experience is designed to balance exploration and relaxation, offering curated routes, swimming stops, and moments of pure connection with Sardinia’s natural beauty.
quote: We had a great time, thank you so much, Fabio!
supportingBody: Every detail is handled so guests can simply relax, explore, and enjoy the freedom of discovering Sardinia from the water.
experienceBody: Sailing along Sardinia’s eastern coast reveals a different perspective of the island, where cliffs meet turquoise waters and secluded beaches appear between stretches of untouched nature. It’s an experience defined by openness, calm, and discovery.
highlights: Relax on board in total comfort
Enjoy a peaceful escape from crowds
Experience Sardinia from a new perspective

reviews.name: Shane Crow
reviews.text:
We had the most amazing day out on the water with Fabio!

He is a great host and it felt like we were out sailing with an old friend from the moment we met! The baunei coastline is perhaps the most beautiful place on the world, and Fabio knows all the best places to go and taylor made the day to the experiences we were looking for. Sailover as a company were so helpful and accomodating from the fist time we reached out to them! Couldn’t recommend Sailover and Fabio enough for the perfect day on the water!

reviews.name: Sophia Ramon
reviews.text: We came to Arbatax to celebrate my father’s 60th birthday, and Fabio made the day incredible! He was an expert tour guide with a ton of knowledge about the area, and he showed us some unique and stunning locations off the Baunei coast! We got to enjoy time as a family, swim and snorkel, enjoy delicious local food and hear stories about the region. Fabio also showed us how to sail and even let us steer the boat for a bit! I would recommend Fabio to anyone looking for a private, lowkey adventure full of sailing, sun, and relaxation!

reviews.name: Don Rizzo
reviews.text: My wife and I spent a day with Fabio on his beautiful boat Luna. We had an amazing day with perfect weather and beautiful blue seas. Fabio could not have been a better host. We had sparkling wine, beer, white wine and a delicious lunch! He was so pleasant and informative. Fabio was easy to talk to and a great person to spend the day with. He is extremely knowledgeable about sailing and Sardinian culture and history. We highly recommend this tour to anybody looking for an intimate, relaxing day on the water.

reviews.name: C Maria
reviews.text: What a trip! We had a brilliant time with Fabio, who was friendly and welcoming. We originally booked a whole day tour, and when the weather outlook changed for the afternoon, Chiara adjusted our trip timings to ensure we still got a fantastic experience. It ended up being better than we could imagine! The aperitivo on board was a lovely touch, it was great to swim with the fish and help with some of the sailing too. If we come back to Arbatax we will definitely book with Fabio again to see even more of the nearby coast! Thank you!

reviews.name: Christiane Pitschl
reviews.text: Fabio is a great skipper. He explains everything you wanna know in technical detail and with a lot of passion. Fabio makes you discover hidden gems, snorkeling was great (lot of fishes) and the water was just amazing. The boat is very clean, food is sardinian-delicious, and Fabio looks after you in every possible way. Highly recommended!
